title: SecOps-NG CACAO extension
description: Normative schema for the SecOps-NG CACAO 2.0 extension (extension-definition--4f4cc5db-ab05-5939-b7af-58a7082d081a). A payload under playbook_extensions matches the playbook shape; a payload under a step's step_extensions matches the step shape. Both shapes are defined once, in playbook.schema.json, and referenced here rather than copied, so the extension cannot drift from the content model.
